MBBS attendance, assessment and progression rules →

On college and hospital days

Carry your student ID, follow the college dress requirements and wear the apron for practical work and clinical postings. Attend teaching sessions and clinical postings on time, and ask the relevant faculty member before leaving a scheduled session.

If you are unwell

Students who are unwell should consult the teaching hospital and inform their warden when rest is advised. Keep the consultation record and check how absence affects attendance with the academic office.

Hostel outings and visitors

Outings require the prescribed parent or guardian request and warden approval, with entry and exit recorded by security. Confirm current gate-pass, return-time and visitor arrangements with the warden.

Dining and library etiquette

Follow mess timings, use food and resources thoughtfully and raise dining concerns in writing with the mess in-charge and warden. In the library, sign the visitors register, keep phones silent and avoid food or anything that disturbs other readers.

Safety and respect

Treat classmates, staff and patients respectfully. Ragging, harassment, substance abuse, examination malpractice and damage to college property are addressed through the applicable college procedures and law. Ask for the current student handbook and committee contacts.

Academic rules and admissions bonds

Attendance, internal assessment, examinations and any admission or discontinuation bonds depend on the rules applicable to your batch. This short guide does not replace the full approved handbook, university notices or legal documents.
